title: Beatrix and the Vector
author: F. M. Dravenmoor
blurb: Quentin Whitlock, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
